clip.hook: FNS: WINNING TEAMS HAVE ISSUES TOO
clip.notes: Successful teams hide internal problems. in_point 7.58, not 3.72: the clip was opening on "here's the other thing you guys have to understand about teams that are succeeding and" — a continuation marker referring to something the viewer never heard, which is rule 3 and the "as I was saying" opening. 7.58 starts on the contrast itself, "obviously for teams that are FAILING you're gonna assume there are problems / for teams that SUCCEED they had prior issues as well", which is the claim and is self-contained. Chat forced on at George's instruction despite 6% topicality. cam left at 344: hiding his "17,082" viewer counter needs the rect top BELOW it, and the pane zoom is 806/height, so every crop that hides it raises the zoom (3.05x -> 3.70x) — which George rejected. The two cannot both be had; the counter is his own overlay and stays. booms: George on the 2-boom build — "first boom is basically pointless, remove, second one is perfect". The budget gives this 31s clip one; the automatic pick would keep 4.84 (+3.96 dB) over 21.92 (+3.83), a 0.13 dB near-tie in a 4 dB range, so the surviving one is named here.  booms override CLEARED ([21.92]): the nucleus gate reaches the same answer on its own, so naming it would hide whether the logic works.
